capabilities: : Move pinned tabs to a sidebar strip
: Display badges with leading characters or file-type icons
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that moves pinned tabs out of the tab header and into a dedicated sidebar strip, so the tab bar keeps its horizontal space for the files you actually switch between.
problem: Pinned tabs consume excessive horizontal space in the tab header, making it difficult to view frequently switched files.
summary: Moves pinned tabs out of the tab header into a dedicated sidebar strip, allowing independent placement control for each tab.
